ol:sanwen.name: 散文
ol:sanwen.description: 每回合限一次，当你获得牌后，若你有与这些牌同名的手牌，你可以展示之并弃置获得的同名牌，然后摸弃牌数两倍的牌。

ol:qiai.name: 七哀
ol:qiai.description: 限定技，当你进入濒死状态时，你可以令每名其他角色各交给你一张牌。

ol:denglou.name: 登楼
ol:denglou.description: 限定技，结束阶段，若你没有手牌，你可以观看牌堆顶的四张牌，然后获得其中的非基本牌，并使用其中的基本牌（不能使用则弃置）。

interpretationsWithoutCombinationFAQ: Sanwen excludes all incoming entities in the same native gain batch from prior-hand witnesses; same-batch duplicates do not witness each other. Names freeze actual effective hand identity at qualification; payment rechecks exact surviving incoming and witnesses. Actual native discard count determines twice-count draw.

Qiai issues clockwise living-player obligations on accepted limited activation; each payer autonomously chooses actual HE transfer. Already paid children drain after source loss/death; dead owner stops future contributions. No recovery is invented.

Denglou uses a private exact frame-owned top-four lease, obtains nonbasics and drains children first, then autonomously orders remaining basics. Native legality is recomputed; no decline when a legal use exists. Unusable basics are actually discarded; death/game-end cleanup uses a separate cancellation reason.
Only real conversion rules supporting the private-reserve source zone can convert leased entities. No hand-only conversion, free distance, extra quota or fake material is granted.
